configuration.fetchxml:
<fetch distinct="true">
   <entity name="skill">
     <attribute name="skillid" />
     <link-entity name="skillrolemapping" from="skillid" to="skillid" link-type="inner" alias="srl">
       <link-entity name="role" from="roleid" to="roleid" link-type="inner" alias="pr">
         <link-entity name="role" from="parentrootroleid" to="roleid" link-type="inner" alias="r">
           <link-entity name="systemuserroles" from="roleid" to="roleid" intersect="true" link-type="outer" alias="ur" />
           <link-entity name="teamroles" from="roleid" to="roleid" intersect="true" link-type="outer" alias="tr">
             <link-entity name="teammembership" from="teamid" to="teamid" intersect="true" link-type="outer" alias="tm" />
           </link-entity>
         </link-entity>
       </link-entity>
     </link-entity>
     <filter type="or">
       <condition entityname="ur" attribute="systemuserid" operator="eq-userid" />
       <condition entityname="tm" attribute="systemuserid" operator="eq-userid" />
     </filter>
   </entity>
 </fetch>
